CustomField.formula: IF ( (No_Planned_Completion_Time__c = TRUE && ISBLANK(Actual_Completion_Time_Local__c) && ISBLANK(Actual_Completion_Time_UTC__c)) || Not_Applicable__c = TRUE, "N.A", IF ( Completed_with_Delay__c = TRUE, "Completed with Delay", IF ( Status_Check__c = "Completed" || (NOT(ISBLANK(Actual_Completion_Time_Local__c)) || NOT(ISBLANK(Actual_Completion_Time_UTC__c))), "Completed", IF ( Status_Check__c = "Overdue", "Overdue", IF ( Status_Check__c = "In Progress", "In Progress", IF ( Status_Check__c = "Not Started", "Not Started", "" ) ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Status(Text)
